title: Chanvoy wait_channel_v3 Parameters
description: Strict parameters for one single-channel wait with profile-daemon single-waiter ownership and optional compare-and-replace.

channel.description: Requested channel name or team/channel selector. Canonical id is resolved at runtime before registry acquisition. The runtime additionally enforces a 256 UTF-8 byte limit.

timeout_secs.description: Required positive u64 duration. The absolute deadline starts at RPC entry and activity does not extend it.

team.description: Optional explicit team override. Null or absent uses the existing resolver chain.

contains.description: Optional case-sensitive literal body substring. Empty is refused at runtime. The runtime additionally enforces a 256 UTF-8 byte limit; JSON Schema maxLength counts code points.

pattern.description: Optional Rust-regex body pattern. Combines with contains using logical AND. Empty is refused. Compiled size is limited at runtime.

after.description: Exclusive baseline post id. Bound to the resolved channel before registry acquisition. Null or absent means tip-at-arm with seam protection after the waiter is admitted.

oneOf.description: Opaque wait id from a prior wait_already_active conflict. Compare-and-replace only; a malformed, stale, absent, or other-channel id is wait_conflict_changed, not a silent steal.
